items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Is it just Doosan or all the members of his band? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, all of them wear their hats.

ctx.x: He used to wear a high roller hat. Big old high roller like a... Stove pipe? Yeah, stove pipe. Big old silk hanker around his neck.
Is it just Doosan or all the members of his band?
Well, all of them wear their hats.
